beats.summary: Michael and Dwight plan a prank on the accounting department, leading to chaos.

evidence.snippet: Michael & Dwight (as they throw accountants' files and supplies around): Ahhhh! Whoo hoo! Come on, come on, come on, come on! Sales rules!

beats.summary: Michael speculates about the cause of damage to his carpet, suggesting it could be an act of terrorism or hate.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Why would somebody ruin a perfectly good carpet? I don't know. It could be done out of hate. It could be done out of love. It could be completely neutral.

beats.summary: Michael decides to cancel the sales contest due to the carpet incident, claiming it was a hate crime.

evidence.snippet: Michael: You know what? Today is not a good day for a sales contest. We're… we're not… we're not doin' this today.
Michael: I am a victim of a hate crime.
